final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and mainly narrowed the claim by reinterpreting the same record. That reinterpretation is partly sound: aggregate readiness and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness, but they do not satisfy the separate disclosure predicate in policy. The distinction matters. A caveated theory could support compliant_with_caveats only if the caveat itself were already implemented in a policy-compliant way, such as a final approved model card disclosing the limitation, or approved risk acceptance. The current record shows neither. It instead shows an unresolved grant-compliance weakness, a draft runbook that fails the approved-mitigation standard, and model-card draft language saying there are no known material limitations. Because the required compliance link remains unproven, the position remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
